### `r stringr::str_to_sentence("{{group}} - {{primerset}} - {{unit}}")`

```{r}
group <- "{{group}}"
primerset <- "{{primerset}}"
unit <- "{{unit}}"
```

```{r}
data_subset <- combined %>%
  filter(
    group == "{{group}}",
    primerset == "{{primerset}}",
    unit == "{{unit}}"
  )
```


```{r}
data_subset %>%
  group_by(landgebruik, diepte) %>%
  summarize(n_simpson_not_missing = sum(!is.na(simpson))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


```{r}
# remove NAs
data_subset <- data_subset %>%
  filter(!is.na(simpson))

diepte_ok <- length(unique(data_subset$diepte)) > 1
```

```{r m-simpson-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
if (diepte_ok) {
  form_simpson <- formula(
    simpson ~
      log(total_count + 1)
    + landgebruik
    + diepte
    + landgebruik:diepte
    + (1 | cmon_plot_id)
  )
} else {
  form_simpson <- formula(
    simpson ~
      log(total_count + 1)
    + landgebruik
    + (1 | cmon_plot_id)
  )
}

cat("Fitting ordinal beta model")

m_simpson <- glmmTMB(
  formula = form_simpson,
  data = data_subset,
  family = ordbeta()
)
```


```{r m-simpson-checks-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}, error = TRUE}
performance::check_model(m_simpson)
```


```{r m-simpson-summary-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
summary(m_simpson) |> print(digits = 2)
```

```{r m-simpson-anova-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}, error = TRUE}
car::Anova(m_simpson) |> print(digits = 2)
```

```{r m-simpson-marginal-means-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
# Estimated marginal means per land use *within each depth layer*
emmeans_landuse_by_depth <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(
  m_simpson,
  variables = "landgebruik",
  newdata = data_subset,
  by = c("diepte", "landgebruik"),
  type = "response"
)

# Save to CSV with automatic naming
write_csv(
  emmeans_landuse_by_depth,
  file = file.path(output_dir, glue("emmeans_simpson_landuse_by_depth_{group}_{primerset}_{unit}.csv"))
)

# print
emmeans_landuse_by_depth
```


```{r m-simpson-contrasts-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
# Compute all pairwise contrasts between land use types within each depth layer
contrasts_landuse_by_depth <- marginaleffects::comparisons(
  model = m_simpson,
  variables = "landgebruik",
  newdata = data_subset,
  type = "response",
  by = "diepte",
  contrast = "pairwise"
) 

# Save to CSV with automatic naming
write_csv(
  contrasts_landuse_by_depth,
  file = file.path(output_dir, glue("contrasts_simpson_landuse_by_depth_{group}_{primerset}_{unit}.csv"))
)

# Print the results
print(contrasts_landuse_by_depth, n = Inf)

```

```{r m-simpson-contrasts-adj-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
# Add BH-corrected p-values per depth group
contrasts_simpson_landuse_by_depth_adj <- contrasts_landuse_by_depth %>%
  group_by(diepte) %>%
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    diepte,
    contrast,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value,
    p_bh
  ) %>%
  arrange(diepte, p.value)

# Save adjusted results to CSV
write_csv(
  contrasts_simpson_landuse_by_depth_adj,
  file = file.path(output_dir, glue("contrasts_simpson_landuse_by_depth_adj_{group}_{primerset}_{unit}.csv"))
)

# Print adjusted summary
print(contrasts_simpson_landuse_by_depth_adj, n = Inf)

```

```{r m-simpson-preds-values-landgebruikxdiepte-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
predicted_values <- marginaleffects::predictions(
  m_simpson,
  condition = c("landgebruik", "diepte"[diepte_ok]),
  re.form = NA,
  vcov = TRUE,
  type = "response"
)

# save to CSV
write_csv(
  predicted_values,
  file = file.path(output_dir, glue("predicted_values_{group}_{primerset}_{unit}.csv"))
)

# View
print(predicted_values)
```

```{r m-simpson-preds-total-count-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}, error = TRUE}
marginaleffects::plot_predictions(

  re.form = NA,

) +

```
